responses.value: Sales likely lagged the market because younger homeowners, who drive its growth, buy plants online instead. I'd compare the chain's sales growth by customer age with the market's.
Revise: the market's growth is houseplants, up 30%, which the centers barely stock; outdoor sales kept pace, so the gap is the range.
Houseplant sales by store against how much shelf space each gives them, this year against last. If stores with bigger houseplant sections grew no faster, I'd drop it.
